dedupe_keys.name: enrezo zones d opportunite pour le developpement des reseaux de chaleur et de froid

description: EnRezo - Zones d'opportunité pour le développement des réseaux de chaleur et de froid is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Cerema. Areas of opportunity for the development of "potential" and "high potential" district heating and cooling networks. Coverage: Cerema. The portal shows the English title as "EnRezo - Areas of opportunity for the development of heating and cooling networks" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Cerema. Its keywords include enrezo, reseaux-de-froid, reseaux-de-chaleur, zones-dopportunite. The listing shows 3 download or service links in XLSX, ZIP. The listing shows 2026-08-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
